firstPartySourceEncoding: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of all cmd/internal Go source path and SHA256 pairs sorted by relative path; contents normalized to UTF-8 LF. All actual main-module production GoFiles must be covered. Generated .pb.go and .proto files or symlinks require a new review.

review.reviewerRole: Independent source and dependency evidence reviewer
review.summary: RC16 independently reviewed 41 changed Go files for gallery previews, bounded file receiving, telemetry isolation and release metadata. No new third-party import paths, generated protobuf or source symlinks were found. Exact Go 1.27.2 observation covers six production targets, 917 first-party files and 106 production modules; Linux closures add five production GoFiles. Excluded not-in-production modules remain absent. Module manifests, upstream torrent source and build targets are unchanged; existing findings and expiry remain unchanged. Full L3 must recompute actual/original closure identity and all scanners. File-share large-file candidate requalification: content-bound sharing grows to 10 GiB with independent legacy upload limits and bounded proof deadlines; no dependency or build-target changes. All changed Go source and direct callers independently reviewed. Six-platform closure identity must be recomputed against the unchanged recorded closure before delivery.
